svg.title: Out of the box, one agent reads its own files. Generators write each agent's files into your project and need a rerun and a new diff after every change. ctxtra hooks into every agent and adds files from your own folder or a pinned team repo through bindings, with nothing written into the projects

g.text: Generators: one source, written out as each agent's files in your project.
Change the source, and those files are stale until you run it again.
Commit the output, and every change to the rules is a diff in your repo.

g.text: ctxtra: start from the same setup. Your agent reads its own files.
Add ctxtra once. It hooks into every supported agent.
Keep your own Markdown files in your own folder.
A binding adds them to every agent session in my-proj.
Another project? Bind files from a shared git repo.
It stays at the commit you accepted. Updates wait for your review.
The agents' own files keep working. ctxtra adds only what you bind.
